depiction.primary_object: two stacked cylindrical discs representing a database
modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: single cylindrical stack with diagonal strike-through

readings.meaning: clear data, purge storage, or wipe cache
no coins, cashless, or zero fee

ambiguity: Can be read as either a database cylinder with a slash (offline/drop database) or a stack of coins with a slash (no cash/no coins), especially outside technical contexts.
task_intents: drop or delete a database instance
clear local application data and cache
test offline mode without database connection

reasoning: Shows a standard stacked-cylinder database glyph struck through with a diagonal slash, clearly indicating deleting, disconnecting, or disabling a database or data storage. It fits technical and sysadmin tasks about dropping databases, purging data, or handling database outages, though non-technical users might occasionally mistake the cylinder stack for coins.
